title: NFC_Ordering_System_Proposal
summary: This solution outlines a lightweight, app-free restaurant self-ordering and hosted checkout system using NTAG213 NFC stickers and static QR codes. Customers tap or scan to open a web ordering page directly via native OS background reading. To prevent tampering, tags are permanently locked to read-only via OTP lock bits. All payment processing is strictly decoupled from the proprietary backend: orders are settled via official PayPay deep links or hosted Stripe/Apple Pay sessions, ensuring zero PCI-DSS compliance burden and preventing transaction spoofing through cryptographically verified webhooks.
